title: Tanco White corn (IPB Var 2): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Tanco White corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Tanco White corn is a white open pollinated corn variety. 97 to 107 days to harvest, 5.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: Tanco White corn is a white open pollinated corn variety, also sold or known as IPB Var 2. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1985. It takes 97 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.06 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 97 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 5.06 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about Tanco White corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Tanco White corn takes 97 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 28 white open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 103 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.06 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.36. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against corn borer, stalk rot, so scout for them from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Tanco White corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is IPB Var 2 the same as Tanco White?
items.a: Yes. IPB Var 2 is another name for Tanco White. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 97 to 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.06 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tanco White?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
